restaurantName: Er Ba Jiu Su Mian Guan
address: 289 Tianzhu Road, Xihu, Hangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Next to Fajing Temple, this tiny vegan joint is always packed with tourists and locals. The location certainly accounts for its popularity… large portion sizes and very affordable prices play their part too. Their signature noodle soup with assorted vegetables has a rich and sweet tomato broth, plus bamboo shoot, peas, fried gluten, wood ear mushroom and cashew nuts. Consider ordering the dumplings filled with dried tofu and potherb mustard to go with it....
pageTitle: Er Ba Jiu Su Mian Guan
